revenue_scope: Total net product sales as printed
geography: United States and Otsuka Territories, not split

approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Lupkynis in combination with a background immunosuppressive therapy regimen

launch_evidence.quote: In January 2021, the Company introduced LUPKYNIS

notes: The printed line is 'Product revenue, net' (2021 to 2024 filings) and 'Net product sales' (from the FY2024 annual report). It is LUPKYNIS total product sales: U.S. specialty pharmacy and distributor sales plus inventory sold to Otsuka for the Otsuka Territories. Aurinia's 10-Q for 2025 Q3 says the product sales line includes sales to Otsuka, and the 2025 10-K geographic note splits only total revenue (U.S. vs Japan), so no U.S.-only quarterly figure is printed and none is derived. The Otsuka component is not separated; the supply agreement is dated August 2022 (10-Q for 2025 Q3). Q4 figures are derived from the annual report less the nine-month figure.
search_log: Bigdata search for LUPKYNIS net product revenue by quarter; Quartr and EDGAR results matched Aurinia's own 10-Q and 8-K lines.
Listed every 10-Q and 10-K for CIK 1600620 via data.sec.gov submissions; fetched each primary document and read the income-statement row for the three-month figure.
Fourth quarters derived as full-year 10-K figure less the nine-month figure in the Q3 10-Q; the sum of four quarters matches each full year.
Checked for a U.S.-only quarterly product line: none printed (geographic split only annually, total revenue).
FDA approval letter for NDA 213716 read for the approval date; the launch quarter comes from the 2025 Q3 10-Q wording.
